## Activity

During October 2025, Oakridge Primary Care completed 105 captures. This activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. The capture activity should continue to be monitored through routine site reporting so that any operational issues can be identified and addressed promptly.

## Image quality

There were 8 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 7.6. These images could not be used for grading and should be considered as part of the site’s routine quality review. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Clear records of these issues will support follow-up and help identify whether further technical action is required.

## Grading

Grading identified 17 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This indicates that grading activity was completed within a short interval during the reporting period. The site should continue to review grading turnaround alongside image quality results, with attention to any recurring issues that may affect the reliability or timeliness of the service.
